{{Top}}
{{Quote|&hellip;a planet that has three suns. There can't be many systems like that&mdash;in fact, only one. Riflor.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Republic 62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref>}}
A '''trinary star system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] consisting of three [[Star/Legends|stars]] orbiting each other. An example of a trinary star system was the [[Riflorii system]], home to the planet [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]]. The planet [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltanna]] was also located in a trinary system.
